selected_experiment.question: Inside the common Nat.succ_le_succ hotspot, do the repeated LE.le Nat instLENat terms collapse through a small number of exact WHNF transition shapes that can replace memoization with a cheaper direct transition?
selected_experiment.target_terms: WHNF requests whose application spine head is LE.le and whose first two arguments are Nat and instLENat

classification_rule.quotient_candidate: at least 99% of sampled target transitions fall into <= 8 exact input-shape -> output-shape classes and at least one class has multiplicity >= 10000
classification_rule.direct_transition_candidate: the dominant output head is stable across both deep-list cases

post_result_policy.if_quotient_candidate_and_direct_transit: freeze a candidate direct LE.le Nat instLENat transition rule and qualify it prospectively against cold/restart/ablation
post_result_policy.if_quotient_candidate_only: compile a transition-family quotient object but do not alter WHNF semantics
post_result_policy.if_no_candidate: compile obstruction against this transition-quotient route and reclose

claim_boundary: Diagnostic-only prospective transition measurement. No LE/Nat semantic rewrite is authorized by this precommit.
